verdict.rationale: The evidence does not document a rules engine in Stripe Treasury that lets users define event-triggered actions. It shows event notifications such as v2.money_management.transaction.created, which are developer building blocks. It also describes platform-built controls and Stripe's own automatic risk controls, neither of which is a user-configurable rule-to-action automation feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
